observations: Front-load washing machine, white cabinet, LG logo on top-left of control panel.
Text on panel reads 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' with a model code partly visible, appears to end in something like 'F1068QDP2' but is small and not fully legible.
Green sticker reads 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability' with LG Dual Inverter branding.

Detergent drawer is visible but not pulled out, so its condition and detergent residue cannot be judged.
No photo of the back (hoses, power cord), the drum interior close-up, the serial plate, or the machine running/spinning.
Floor and surroundings suggest an outdoor or semi-covered storage area, consistent with exposure to moisture explaining the rust.
